description: Schema definition used to create the Season Result data model (layer 8/9 of the Poutine League Dataverse data model build-out): rpo_SeasonResult (header/snapshot) + rpo_SeasonResultEntry (ranked-entry child table). Source of truth: ARCHITECTURE.md Sec 1 (Data model), SEASON_RESULT entity block + Confirmed decisions (full ranked-list snapshot per season/category, not just top-1).

designDecision.problem: Dataverse cannot store an array/list inside a single row, but ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Confirmed decisions' requires Season Result to store a FULL ranked-list snapshot per season/category, not just the top-1 winner.
designDecision.decisionMadeBy: Coordinating session (layer orchestrator), made autonomously in the human's absence -- flagged prominently for human review/adjustment in the PR description.
designDecision.chosenApproach: Relational decomposition: rpo_SeasonResult is the header/snapshot row (one per season+category), and a NEW 10th supporting table rpo_SeasonResultEntry holds one row per ranked entry within that snapshot (1:N child of rpo_SeasonResult). This is a relational-decomposition implementation detail of the existing Season Result entity, not new business scope.
rejectedAlternatives: Fixed top-N columns (e.g. rank1id, rank2id, ...) on rpo_SeasonResult

tables.purpose: Header/snapshot record: one row per season+category combination, representing the persisted, nightly-computed leaderboard standing.

columns.notes: Primary name column, auto-created with the table. Seed data composes '<Season name> - <Category name>' since Season Result has no other natural name.

Timestamp of when the nightly leaderboard computation ran. Created via raw Web API with explicit Format=DateAndTime and DateTimeBehavior=UserLocal from the start (per the documented gotcha from layers 3/4) -- no delete+recreate cycle was needed this time.

tables.purpose: NEW 10th supporting table (not in the original ARCHITECTURE.md table list). One row per ranked entry within a Season Result snapshot -- relational decomposition of the 'ranked entries' list described in ARCHITECTURE.md, per the design decision above.

columns.notes: Primary name column, auto-created with the table. Seed data composes '<Category name> rank <N> (<Season name>)'.
1 = top rank within the parent Season Result's ranked list.
The computed score for this entry (semantics depend on the parent Category's computationtype -- e.g. try count, weighted rating, helpfulness score).

lookups.creationMethod: client.tables.create_lookup_field() -- worked as-is (referenced table already carries the rpo prefix). This is the required N:1 parent relationship.

client.tables.create_lookup_field() FAILS for lookups to systemuser (documented gotcha from layers 3/4: auto-generated relationship schema name lacks a customization prefix). Worked around by calling client.tables.create_one_to_many_relationship() directly with LookupAttributeMetadata + OneToManyRelationshipMetadata, supplying an explicit rpo_-prefixed relationship schema name ('rpo_SeasonResultEntry_Employee') and RequiredLevel=None.
lookups.notes: Nullable. Populated only when the parent Category's computationtype is employee-based (try_count_by_submitter, try_count_by_employee, review_helpfulness_score). Exactly one of rpo_EmployeeId / rpo_PoutineSubmissionId is populated per row -- never both, never neither. Validated in scripts/validate_season_result_data.py.

lookups.notes: Nullable. Populated only when the parent Category's computationtype is poutine-based (weighted_rating). Exactly one of rpo_EmployeeId / rpo_PoutineSubmissionId is populated per row.

solutionAttachment.verificationMethod: Queried solutioncomponent for componenttype=1 and confirmed both rpo_seasonresult (MetadataId d3e48e32-b05b-4690-9a46-7ddb63dfa834) and rpo_seasonresultentry (MetadataId 360dcc42-b885-4b4c-a29e-2b4e346134d6) are present in poutineleaguecore, attached automatically via the solution= parameter on client.tables.create() (no pac solution add-solution-component call was needed for either table, consistent with layer 4's finding).

creationMethod.tool: PowerPlatform-Dataverse-Client (Python SDK) with raw Web API for the rpo_ComputedAt DateTime column.
creationMethod.phasedCreation: Both tables created first, waited 30s, then non-lookup columns (rpo_Rank, rpo_Score), waited 30s, then rpo_ComputedAt via raw Web API, waited 30s, then all 5 lookups created sequentially with ~20s pauses between each.
creationMethod.noNewGotchas: The documented gotchas from layers 3/4 (systemuser lookup relationship naming, DateTime column creation) were applied proactively from the start this time and both worked cleanly on first attempt -- no delete+recreate cycles were needed.
